question: Write $x-2y=0$ and $3x+y=7$ in matrix form. Solve the system and verify the obtained solution.
explanation:
Matrix representation
The system is $$\begin{bmatrix}1&-2\\3&1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x\\y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}0\\7\end{bmatrix}$$
Substitution
From $x-2y=0$, $$x=2y$$
Determination of the variables
Substituting in $3x+y=7$, $$6y+y=7$$ Hence, $y=1$ and $x=2$.
Verification
The values satisfy $2-2(1)=0$ and $3(2)+1=7$. Therefore, the solution is $(2,1)$.
